en.hubeali:
From him, from Saeed Bin Janah, from a number of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Kaaba, in the era of Ibrahim<sup>as</sup> was of ten cubits, and for it were two doors. Abdullah Bin Al-Zubeyr built it, so he raised it to eighteen cubits. Al-Hajjaj demolished it, and he built it to twenty seven cubits’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from him (narrator of previous Hadith) from Sa‘id ibn Junah from a number of our people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the height of al-Ka‘bah at the time of Ibrahim was nine yards and it had two doors. ‘Abd Allah ibn Zubayr raised it to eighteen yards. Hajjaj destroyed it and raised it to twenty-seven yards.”
